Gentle care for the whole family

Welcome to Brightwater Dental Clinic

Brightwater Dental Clinic has looked after families in the town of Riverton for many years. Our small team of dentists, hygienists and assistants offers routine check-ups, professional cleaning, fillings, crowns, orthodontic braces for children and adults, and same-day emergency appointments when a tooth cannot wait until next week.

We believe a visit to the dentist should be calm and predictable. Every treatment starts with a conversation: we explain what we see, show you the images, and give you a written plan with the cost of each step before any work begins. You are always free to take the plan home and think it over.

Our services

Check-ups and cleaning

A full examination, digital images when needed and a cleaning by a hygienist, usually in one visit of under an hour.

Fillings and crowns

Tooth-coloured fillings and crowns made to match your own teeth, with local anaesthetic for a comfortable visit.

Braces

Clear aligners and classic braces for teenagers and adults, with a free first consultation and a monthly payment plan.

Emergency care

Broken tooth, swelling or sharp pain: call in the morning and we will find you a slot on the same day.

How to book a visit

Book by phone during opening hours or use the request form on the contacts page. Tell us whether you are a new patient and what the visit is about, and the front desk will call you back with the first free time. Please bring a list of any medicines you take and the results of earlier treatment if you have them.

Opening hours are Monday to Friday from eight in the morning until seven in the evening, and Saturday from nine until one.
